task_completion.description: A tiddler titled 'New Patient Registration Form' is created and open in the TiddlyWiki interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see a tiddler with the exact title 'New Patient Registration Form' in the story river.

task_completion.description: The form contains input fields for 'patient_name', 'dob', and 'physician'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see three distinct input boxes or labels corresponding to the three required fields within the form tiddler.

task_completion.description: The form code or behavior indicates usage of '$:/temp/NewPatient' for data storage.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the tiddler's edit mode or via interaction, there is evidence that inputs are mapped to fields of the '$:/temp/NewPatient' tiddler.

task_completion.description: A button labeled 'Register Patient' is visible within the form.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A button element with the exact text 'Register Patient' is visible inside the 'New Patient Registration Form' tiddler.

task_completion.description: The button is configured to create a new tiddler with the title from 'patient_name', tagged 'Patient', with 'dob' and 'physician' fields.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should observe the agent writing code (e.g., <$button> with <$action-createtiddler>) that specifies the title, the 'Patient' tag, and the specific fields.

task_completion.description: The button logic includes the specific body text '!! Intake Notes\n* ' and an action to delete '$:/temp/NewPatient'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the specific string '!! Intake Notes' followed by a newline and an asterisk in the code, along with a <$action-deletetiddler> for the state tiddler.

integrity.description: The agent used the TiddlyWiki GUI to create and edit the tiddler rather than just manipulating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent clicking 'plus' buttons, typing into the TiddlyWiki editor, and clicking 'save' icons.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply import a pre-existing tiddler file containing the solution.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen manually typing or constructing the wikitext/macro code within the browser interface.

integrity.description: The agent tests the form to ensure it actually generates a tiddler and clears the state.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show a new tiddler appearing with the 'Patient' tag after the 'Register Patient' button is clicked.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The form must be titled 'New Patient Registration Form'. It must use '$:/temp/NewPatient' as the temporary state tiddler. The generated tiddler must have the tag 'Patient', fields 'dob' and 'physician', and the body must be exactly '!! Intake Notes\n* ' (note the newline and trailing space). The state tiddler must be deleted upon button click.
